D01.note_text: On the 12th of October, Ryan Hale put his hands around Leanne's neck in the hallway while she opened the door to give Mia's bag, causing her to be unable to breathe for a period. ... Leanne's neighbour called the police ... and Ryan Hale was arrested.
D01.why: act, body part, date, place, breathing and arrest all kept

D02.label: accurate
D02.note_text: On the 3rd of November, Ryan Hale sent a text message to Leanne threatening to kill her, which she has screenshot and also has voice notes saying 'I'll regret it'.
D02.why: threat to kill, text, date and voice notes kept

D03.label: accurate
D03.note_text: On the 20th of October, Ryan Hale arrived again and smashed Leanne's phone, which she had to replace at a cost of about two hundred pounds.
D03.why: smashed phone and date kept; 'grabbed it out of my hand' not stated but substance intact
